display_name: Two cross-references in the Securities Law, 5728-1968, that name a repealed section, recorded as typed values with their tests: item (2) of Part C of the Seventh Schedule citing the repealed s 35ד(ב)(2), and s 56(ב) listing the repealed s 14א (two defects), with two controls (a parallel Fifth Schedule item conformed by the same Amendment, and s 56(ב)'s sound citation of s 38); not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the person to whom the Law is applied: a corporation to which the Law's duties apply, or an interested party or senior officer of one. The row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

source.deposit_kind: excerpt of the Hebrew Wikisource page, ten blocks of whole-page lines copied unaltered

whole_page.note: the whole page as retrieved on 2026-11-10; not deposited

source.note: the consolidation is an unofficial aid; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ with their page images.

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of two defects, each stating what the citing words need. Item (2) of Part C of the Seventh Schedule cites s 35ד(ב)(2), and s 35ד was repealed by Sefer HaChukim 2380 p. 681, s 7, in force three months after publication on 8 August 2012 (p. 694, s 29(א)); the row types 9 November 2012 as the first day certain on either counting. Section 56(ב) lists s 14א, which Sefer HaChukim 2253 p. 617, s 9(1), repealed from 15 December 2010 (p. 619, s 13). The wording of neither repealed provision was read.

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the five official pages were read by the builder
